post.description: By using either buyer_id OR card_token, capture an amount from the available credit. Optionally reference a pre-existing authorization.

400.description:
Bad request
Error CodeDescription
amount_mismatchThe amounts specified in the charge are not equal to the sum of the amounts in charge details
buyer_currency_mismatchThe specified currency is not matched with buyer currency
buyer_mismatchThe buyer on the Credit charge does not match the buyer of the referenced Sale charge identified by previous_charge_id. The Credit charge must be issued by the same buyer as the original Sale charge
cannot_override_payment_termsThe charge_payment_days needs to be a valid value and the buyer must not be consolidated
charge_credit_is_not_supportedThe charge type of credit is not supported
currency_mismatchThe currency of the Credit charge does not match the currency of the referenced Sale charge via previous_charge_id
detail_amount_mismatchThe amounts specified in the charge details are not equal to the subtotal of the detail in charge details
deferred_processing_not_allowedThis program is not configured to allow deferred processing
discount_amount_mismatchThe discount amount specified in the charge is not equal to the sum of the discount amount in charge details
duplicate_charge_idThe provided id already exists. Use a unique charge ID
invalid_authorizationInvalid authorization for the ID specified
invalid_buyerBuyer does not exist or inactive
invalid_card_numberCard for the given card number does not exist, is inactive, or has expired
invalid_card_service_card_idCard for the given card service card ID does not exist, is inactive, or has expired
invalid_card_tokenCard for the given card token does not exist, is inactive, or has expired
invalid_charge_details_tax_detailsInvalid charge.details.tax_details were supplied.
invalid_countryinvalid country code in the company address
invalid_amount_for_creditThe total_amount specified for the credit transaction exceeds the remaining uncredited amount of the original charge. Credit amounts must be less than or equal to the uncredited portion of the referenced Sale charge
invalid_customer_group_idThe customer_group_id that was provided is not associated with the buyer or does not exist
invalid_inputOne of the request inputs is not valid
invalid_poPurchase Order number is invalid or does not match expected format
invalid_po_formatPurchase Order number format does not match policy rules
invalid_po_not_uniquePurchase Order number is not unique
invalid_programSeller and Buyer are not in the same program
invalid_previous_charge_idThe provided previous_charge_id is invalid. Ensure it is a correctly formatted UUID and references an existing charge in the system. When creating a Credit charge, the previous_charge_id must reference an existing Sale charge that is in a creditable state (e.g., status is not Rejected, Cancelled or Pending Payment)
invalid_request_errorAn unhandled error was received from the payment provider. See the `message` field for details.
invalid_sellerSeller for the given ID does not exist or inactive
invalid_shipping_amountShipping amount + shipping tax amount - shipping discount amount cannot be less than 0
invoice_insured_auth_requires_preauthorizationWhen program.insured_auth_enabled is true, invoice can only be created with a preauthorization that has is_insured set to true
missing_programThe associated Program was not found
po_requiredPurchase Order number is required
pricing_errorsOne or more of the charge details has a pricing validation error. Please check the response for specific details regarding the error
program_credit_limit_exceededCredit charge exceeds the maximum allowed for this program.
require_authorizationA valid authorization must be provided with the charge due to the requirement set on your program
require_card_verification_valuecard_verification_value is required when the charge does not have a valid authorization and is_card_present = false
require_charge_details_tax_detailsThe invoice country require charge.details.tax_details
require_is_card_presentis_card_present is required when the charge does not have a valid authorization
require_item_codeWhen pricing is enabled, charge.details.item_code is required
require_shipping_tax_detailsThe invoice country require charge.details.tax_details
seller_mismatchThe seller on the Credit charge does not match the seller of the referenced Sale charge identified by previous_charge_id. Or the provided buyer and seller combination is invalid.
shipping_tax_amount_mismatchThe shipping tax amount specified in the charge is not equal to the sum of the tax amount in shipping tax details.
tax_amount_mismatchThe tax amount specified in the charge is not equal to the sum of the tax amount in charge details
unsupported_currencyThe specified currency is not supported for the seller
unsupported_operationThe operation needs to be enabled for the program
validation.body_not_matching_json_schemaRequest body failed JSON schema validation. The `validationErrors` property contain information regarding which parts of the payload not passing validation.
validation.unsupported_media_typeUnsupported media type
withhold_seller_amount_too_largewithhold_seller_amount is greater than the charge total_amount
withhold_seller_amount_not_supportedWithholding seller amounts is not supported for this program
